title: Brief
description: Container for one weekly sensing brief (A-2): the period it covers, its freeze date (provenance.frozenOn) and which signals it contains. It holds signal identifiers, not signals, so a signal's text exists in exactly one place. The order of signalIds carries no meaning: the UI orders by publication date (C-4), so the Brief Editor cannot express a preference through list position. maxItems equals BRIEF_SIGNAL_CAP (5, a maximum: Q-3, DM-9); M1-U5 keeps the two in step and M5-U1 tests the count. Zero signals is valid and gives F2-S0. Shipped in data/brief.js.

label.description: The brief as an assembled whole is the one container labelled frozen (DM-2); its signals carry their own labels.
